parameters.query: SELECT account_id, business_name, sheet_id, calendar_id, timezone FROM receply_clients ORDER BY account_id

SELECT r.calendar_event_id AS "EventID", coalesce(g.first_name, '') AS "Name", coalesce(g.phone, '') AS "PhoneNumber", coalesce(r.room_number, '') AS "RoomNumber"
  FROM receply_reservations r LEFT JOIN receply_guests g ON g.id = r.guest_id
 WHERE r.account_id = $1::int AND r.status = 'confirmed' AND r.calendar_event_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.check_in BETWEEN current_date - 2 AND current_date + 7

SELECT calendar_event_id AS event_id, conversation_id, whatsapp_phone FROM receply_reservations
 WHERE account_id = $1::int AND calendar_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (conversation_id IS NOT NULL OR whatsapp_phone IS NOT NULL)
